text_en: As Jesus came out of the temple and was going away, his disciples came to point out to him the buildings of the temple.
text_cn: 耶稣由圣殿里出来前行，门徒前来把圣殿的建筑指给他看。

text_en: Then he asked them, “You see all these, do you not? Truly I tell you, not one stone will be left here upon another; all will be thrown down. ”
text_cn: 耶稣回答他们说：“你们不是看见这一切吗？我实在告诉你们：将来这里决没有一块石头，留在另一块石头上，而不被拆毁的。”

text_en: When he was sitting on the Mount of Olives, the disciples came to him privately, saying, “Tell us, when will this be, and what will be the sign of your coming and of the end of the age? ”
text_cn: 他在橄榄山上坐着的时候，门徒前来私下对他说：“请告诉我们：什么时候要发生这些事？又什么是你来临和时代穷尽的先兆？”

text_en: Jesus answered them, “Beware that no one leads you astray.
text_cn: 耶稣回答说：“你们要谨慎，免得有人欺骗你们，

text_en: For many will come in my name, saying, ‘I am the Messiah! ’ and they will lead many astray.
text_cn: 因为将有许多人假冒我的名字来说：我就是默西亚；他们要欺骗许多人。

text_en: And you will hear of wars and rumors of wars; see that you are not alarmed; for this must take place, but the end is not yet.
text_cn: 你们要听到战争和战争的风声。小心，不要惊慌！因为这是必须发生的，但还不是结局，

text_en: For nation will rise against nation, and kingdom against kingdom, and there will be famines and earthquakes in various places:
text_cn: 因为民族要起来攻击民族，国家要起来攻击国家；并且到处要有饥荒、瘟疫和地震。

text_en: all this is but the beginning of the birth pangs.
text_cn: 但是，这一切只是痛苦的开始。

text_en: “Then they will hand you over to be tortured and will put you to death, and you will be hated by all nations because of my name.
text_cn: 那时，人要交付你们去受刑，要杀害你们；你们为了我的名字，要为各民族所憎恨。

text_en: Then many will fall away, and they will betray one another and hate one another.
text_cn: 那时，必有许多人要跌倒，互相出卖，互相仇恨；

text_en: And many false prophets will arise and lead many astray.
text_cn: 许多假先知要起来，欺骗许多人；

text_en: And because of the increase of lawlessness, the love of many will grow cold.
text_cn: 由于罪恶的增加，许多人的爱情必要冷淡。

text_en: But the one who endures to the end will be saved.
text_cn: 唯独坚持到底的，才可得救。

text_en: And this good news of the kingdom will be proclaimed throughout the world, as a testimony to all the nations; and then the end will come.
text_cn: 天国的福音必先在全世界宣讲，给万民作证；然后结局才会来到。

text_en: “So when you see the desolating sacrilege standing in the holy place, as was spoken of by the prophet Daniel (let the reader understand),
text_cn: 所以，几时你们见到达尼尔所说的‘招致荒凉的可憎之物’已立于圣地，──读者应明白：

text_en: then those in Judea must flee to the mountains;
text_cn: 那时在犹太的，该逃往山中；

text_en: the one on the housetop must not go down to take what is in the house;
text_cn: 在屋顶上的，不要下来，从自己的屋里，取什么东西；

text_en: the one in the field must not turn back to get a coat.
text_cn: 在田野里的，也不要回来取他的外衣。

text_en: Woe to those who are pregnant and to those who are nursing infants in those days!
text_cn: 在那些日子内，怀孕的和哺乳的，是有祸的。

text_en: Pray that your flight may not be in winter or on a sabbath.
text_cn: 你们当祈祷，不要叫你们的逃遁遇到冬天或安息日。”

text_en: For at that time there will be great suffering, such as has not been from the beginning of the world until now, no, and never will be.
text_cn: 因为那时必有大灾难，是从宇宙开始，直到如今从未有过的，将来也不会再有；

text_en: And if those days had not been cut short, no one would be saved; but for the sake of the elect those days will be cut short.
text_cn: 并且那些时日如不缩短，凡有血肉的，都不会得救；但为了那些被选的，那些时日，必将缩短。

text_en: Then if anyone says to you, ‘Look! Here is the Messiah! ’ or ‘There he is! ’—do not believe it.
text_cn: 那时，若有人对你们说：看，默西亚在这里！或说：在那里！你们不要相信，

text_en: For false messiahs and false prophets will appear and produce great signs and omens, to lead astray, if possible, even the elect.
text_cn: 因为将有假默西亚和假先知兴起，行大奇迹和异迹，以致如果可能，连被选的人也要被欺骗。

text_en: Take note, I have told you beforehand.
text_cn: 看，我预先告诉了你们。

text_en: So, if they say to you, ‘Look! He is in the wilderness, ’ do not go out. If they say, ‘Look! He is in the inner rooms, ’ do not believe it.
text_cn: 为此，如果有人对你们说：看，他在旷野。你们不要出来。或说：看，在内室。你们也不要相信。

text_en: For as the lightning comes from the east and flashes as far as the west, so will be the coming of the Son of Man.
text_cn: 因为如同闪电从东方发出，直照到西方，人子的来临也要这样。

text_en: Wherever the corpse is, there the vultures will gather.
text_cn: 无论在那里有死尸，老鹰就聚集在那里。”

text_en: “Immediately after the suffering of those days the sun will be darkened, and the moon will not give its light; the stars will fall from heaven, and the powers of heaven will be shaken.
text_cn: “那些时日的灾难一过，立时太阳就要昏暗，月亮也不发光，星辰要从天上坠下，天上的万象也要动摇。

text_en: Then the sign of the Son of Man will appear in heaven, and then all the tribes of the earth will mourn, and they will see ‘the Son of Man coming on the clouds of heaven’ with power and great glory.
text_cn: 那时，人子的记号要出现天上；地上所有的种族，都要哀号，要看见人子带着威能和大光荣，乘着天上的云彩降来。

text_en: And he will send out his angels with a loud trumpet call, and they will gather his elect from the four winds, from one end of heaven to the other.
text_cn: 他要派遣他的天使，用发出洪声的号角，由四方，从天这边到天那边，聚集他所拣选的人。”

text_en: “From the fig tree learn its lesson: as soon as its branch becomes tender and puts forth its leaves, you know that summer is near.
text_cn: “你们应该由无花果取个比喻：几时它的枝条已经发嫩，叶子出生了，你们就知道夏天近了。

text_en: So also, when you see all these things, you know that he is near, at the very gates.
text_cn: 同样，你们几时看见这一切，你们就该知道：他已近了，就在门口。

text_en: Truly I tell you, this generation will not pass away until all these things have taken place.
text_cn: 我实在告诉你们：非到这一切发生了，这一世代决不会过去。

text_en: Heaven and earth will pass away, but my words will not pass away.
text_cn: 天地要过去，但是我的话，决不会过去。”

text_en: “But about that day and hour no one knows, neither the angels of heaven, nor the Son, but only the Father.
text_cn: “至于那日子和那时刻，除父一个外，谁也不知道，连天上的天使都不知道。

text_en: For as the days of Noah were, so will be the coming of the Son of Man.
text_cn: 就如在诺厄的时日怎样，人子的来临也要怎样。

text_en: For as in those days before the flood they were eating and drinking, marrying and giving in marriage, until the day Noah entered the ark,
text_cn: 因为就如在洪水以前的时日，人照常吃喝婚嫁，直到诺厄进入方舟的那一天，

text_en: and they knew nothing until the flood came and swept them all away, so too will be the coming of the Son of Man.
text_cn: 仍然没有觉察；直到洪水来了，把他们都卷了去；人子的来临，也必要这样。

text_en: Then two will be in the field; one will be taken and one will be left.
text_cn: 那时，两个人同在田间，一个被提去，一个却被遗弃；

text_en: Two women will be grinding meal together; one will be taken and one will be left.
text_cn: 两个女人同在磨旁推磨，一个被提去，一个却被遗弃。

text_en: Keep awake therefore, for you do not know on what day your Lord is coming.
text_cn: 所以，你们要醒寤，因为你们不知道：在那一天你们的主人要来。

text_en: But understand this: if the owner of the house had known in what part of the night the thief was coming, he would have stayed awake and would not have let his house be broken into.
text_cn: 这一点你们要明白：如果家主知道，盗贼几更天要来，他必要醒寤，不让自己的房屋被挖穿。

text_en: Therefore you also must be ready, for the Son of Man is coming at an unexpected hour.
text_cn: 为此，你们应该准备，因为你们不料想的时辰，人子就来了。”

text_en: “Who then is the faithful and wise slave, whom his master has put in charge of his household, to give the other slaves their allowance of food at the proper time?
text_cn: “究竟谁是那忠信聪明的仆人，主人派他管理自己的家仆，按时配给他们食粮呢？

text_en: Blessed is that slave whom his master will find at work when he arrives.
text_cn: 主人来时，看见他如此行事，那仆人才是有福的。

text_en: Truly I tell you, he will put that one in charge of all his possessions.
text_cn: 我实在告诉你们：主人必要委派他管理自己的一切财产。

text_en: But if that wicked slave says to himself, ‘My master is delayed, ’
text_cn: 如果那恶仆心里说：我主人必要迟延，

text_en: and he begins to beat his fellow slaves, and eats and drinks with drunkards,
text_cn: 于是开始拷打自己的同伴，甚或同醉汉一起吃喝。

text_en: the master of that slave will come on a day when he does not expect him and at an hour that he does not know.
text_cn: 正在他不期待的日子，和想不到的时刻，那仆人的主人要来到，

text_en: He will cut him in pieces and put him with the hypocrites, where there will be weeping and gnashing of teeth.
text_cn: 铲除他，使他与假善人遭受同样的命运；在那里要有哀号和切齿。”
